for the 2026 SEC Gymnastics Championship, which will be held on Saturday, March 21 at the BOK Center in Tulsa, Okla.BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (January 28, 2026) – The Southeastern Conference announced that tickets will go on sale tomorrow for the 2026 SEC Gymnastics Championship, which will be held on Saturday, March 21 at the BOK Center in Tulsa, Okla. Tickets range from $30 to $45 (plus applicable service fees) and provide admission to both sessions of the championship. In addition, student tickets will be available for purchase for $17. The Championship consists of two sessions. Seeds 5-9 will compete in Session I at 2 p.m. CT, and seeds 1-4 will compete in Session II at 7 p.m. CT. Tickets can be purchased online at SECSports.com or through the BOK Center box office. Since the inaugural NCAA Women’s Gymnastics Championship in 1982, the SEC has placed at least one team in all 43 championship meets. Programs from the SEC have won 21 NCAA team championships in women’s gymnastics. In 2025, Oklahoma won its seventh National Title to become the fifth SEC program to be crowned the National Champion, joining Alabama, Florida, Georgia and LSU. In last season’s national rankings, all nine SEC programs were ranked in the top 20.
